sections.title: Mentored Research I
sections.description: In this research assistantship, MBE or MSME students work closely with a faculty member to produce a piece of publishable-quality co-authored scholarship through engagement in a faculty member’s ongoing research. For students in the MBE program, there will be a limited number of projects offered each academic year to which MBE students may apply. Each faculty member will design their own application process for these research assistantships. MSME will work with their faculty advisor to design their independent research agenda with faculty collaboration.

sections.title: Mentored Research I
sections.description: This course gives postdoctoral students the opportunity to work with a faculty mentor for one semester. The student chooses a specialized topic in Bioethics and identifies a problem to which they apply research and draw some conclusion. The faculty mentor assesses and submits a grade for this work. This is often resulting in a publishable quality paper.
